Reuben Thomas Freestone

1888–1984

Open in the family tree

Names in the records
Rueben Thomas Freestone
Born
April 11, 1888
Died

The family account lists Reuben among the children of George Freestone and Jennie Lind. He married Adora Elvira Batty; they were the parents of Clyde Thomas Freestone.
